title: Reusable evidence custody and interchange without a global truth database
claim: A private portfolio evidence-custody implementation may provide narrow reusable evidence-record and custody mechanics to independent projects while each project retains its own database, semantics, privacy boundary, and authority.
preserved_boundaries: Lantern records do not decide project-specific truth or authority.
rejection_conditions: Consumers must adopt Lantern-specific domain semantics rather than neutral custody mechanics.
Lantern becomes a mandatory single point of failure.
Interchange loses project-specific provenance or privacy constraints.
A second materially independent real consumer cannot be demonstrated.

critical_objections: A common evidence format can become a hidden common ontology.
Operational convenience may pressure projects into centralizing state.

notes: The private implementation identity is intentionally not published by this public repository.
The first task is to make the candidate custody implementation a truthful, installable package before judging reuse.
